title: Healthcare × Technology
positioning: Building at the intersection of business, technology and healthcare innovation.
statement: I am passionate about exploring how technology, analytics, AI and product thinking can transform healthcare experiences — from digital health platforms to AI-driven clinical decision-making and data-driven care.

pillars.label: Digital Health Platforms
pillars.detail: Interest in the products and workflows that connect patients, clinicians and care teams.

pillars.label: Healthcare Technology
pillars.detail: Research experience translating clinical/hospice datasets into predictive, actionable models.

pillars.label: Artificial Intelligence
pillars.detail: Applying ML to real health outcomes — mortality risk prediction, aging and chronic care innovation.

pillars.label: Data Analytics
pillars.detail: Turning healthcare data into visualized, decision-ready findings for research and product teams.

pillars.label: Digital Transformation
pillars.detail: Bridging business requirements and engineering execution to bring digital health platforms to production.

researchNote.detail: Conducted mortality risk prediction using hospice datasets from AMOR wellness watches under a fully funded International Internship Pilot Program (IIPP), contributing to research papers and academic presentations on AI innovation for aging and chronic care.
